description: Looks up one US state, or the District of Columbia, in the dataset "U.S. State Auto Repair Estimate Laws" published by RepairWorth. Returns the row as published: its `status` (verified, no_statute_found or lead), the statute citation, the URL of the official state source, the rules on written estimates, on exceeding the estimate without new consent and on returning replaced parts, a verbatim quote of the official text, and the date it was checked. An empty value means "not established from the source read", not "no rule". Only state-level law is covered. Not legal advice. Verify the official text. This dataset summarizes public legal texts for research and consumer information. Laws change, and a short summary can miss exceptions. Read the official text, or ask a lawyer, before relying on any row.

state.description: Two-letter USPS code of a US state, or DC.

name: state_estimate_law
title: Look Up a State Estimate Law
